description: List Depot CI runs, newest first. Filter by status (default: running + queued — pass ["failed"] to find failures), repo, commit SHA prefix, trigger event, or pull request number (requires repo). Depot: CIService/ListRuns.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

repo.description: Repository in owner/name format, e.g. depot/cli.

status.description: Run statuses to include (ORed). Default on Depot's side: running and queued.

trigger.description: Trigger event, e.g. push, pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch.

name: depot_ci_list_runs
title: List Depot CI runs
